item.title: Tesla promotes EMEA exec Joe Ward to lead global sales amid European collapse
item.description: Tesla has named Joe Ward, its Vice President for Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), to oversee global sales operations, according to a report from Bloomberg. The move comes as Tesla’s automotive business continues to struggle, particularly in Europe where sales have collapsed over the past two years. more…
